examples.scenario: The upper-left pixel is referenced at raster coordinate 0,0
examples.reason: The geotransform origin is the pixel corner; the sample centre is half a pixel inward.

examples.scenario: A PixelIsPoint GeoTIFF is opened under a legacy compatibility setting
examples.reason: Different interpretation can move the apparent grid by half a cell.

examples.scenario: A parcel vertex lies exactly on the right edge of column 10
examples.reason: Implicit round versus floor choices can assign the coordinate to different cells.
Rounding offsets and lengths independently can otherwise omit an intersecting edge cell.

examples.scenario: A geometry extends one pixel beyond the raster extent
examples.reason: Synthetic fill cells must not enter parcel extrema.

examples.scenario: A 10 by 10 source window is read into a 5 by 5 buffer
examples.reason: Buffer-size mismatch invokes reduced-resolution sampling and may use overviews.

examples.scenario: A rotated affine transform cannot be inverted
examples.reason: Row and column indices cannot be certified without a successful inverse transform.

examples.scenario: Three accepted native cells share the same maximum decoded elevation
examples.reason: Choosing only the first tied cell loses reproducibility and edge-sensitivity evidence.
